value.rationale: An exact interpolation stability-design problem is solved over all data-independent convex secant blends, including spatially nonperiodic choices: optimal BV growth approaches one under extreme alternating mesh contrast, although the uniform design has 35/27 amplification. The telescoping obstruction and explicit squared-length optimum are structural, motivated by sensitivity to sharp data jumps and mesh design. The result is limited to affine reproduction, not all possible interpolation schemes.
